{{Top|leg}}
A '''monitor pad''' was a part of a [[Breath mask/Legends|face breather]] like the one used by [[Deeve]], a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] of the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]]. It could be activated by flicking the tongue over it, and at doing so, it initiated a quick analysis of the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], saying whether it was suitable to be breathed or not.
